clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, the Bloodstone Choker binds a warlock’s ritual to the void. Gakin the Darkbinder once held the bloodstone talisman, until an apprentice stole it and fled to the Defias Brotherhood.

Carved from bloodstone, the choker can bridge the mortal world and the twisting shadows of the Twisting Nether. Gakin puts it to use in the crypts beneath the tavern, channeling its magic at the summoning circle to draw a hostile Voidwalker from the void. A warlock must subdue the furious creature in direct combat while wielding the talisman to prove the will to command such a guardian.
